title: Aureline M5 scaffold-template-card component
description: Documents the controlled vocabulary the scaffold-template-card family binds inside the frozen M5 scaffold-component matrix (schemas/ui/m5-scaffold-component-matrix.schema.json). A scaffold template card names where a starter comes from and how it is supported so a card never leaves its starter source or support class implicit and never presents bridge or heuristic behavior as exact first-party support. The Rust validator in crates/aureline-templates is the authoritative gate; this schema documents the family's shape.
